White Pleated Collared Mini Dress
Rights check
Source: 24411.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with shoulder-length light
brown hair stands on a green lawn. She wears a fitted
sleeveless white collared dress with a deep V neckline
and a pleated mini skirt with a brown leather belt. She
carries a gray quilted shoulder bag on a tan strap. Her
expression is calm, looking off to the side. Soft, natural
daylight. Palette of white, green, and warm brown.
Fresh and preppy, in the style of a summer street-style
editorial.
Preppy, fresh, sporty
WORKING NOTES
- The pleated skirt and collared neckline are the key
details.
- Add 'full-length' to show the belt and skirt hem.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the belt and skirt
hem.
